subject: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@finco.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: Paul Darcy <paul.darcy@finco.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick responses during yesterday's call. As part of FinCo's validation for the engagement scope (internal penetration testing results), our security team needs a short package confirming the closure of the findings we discussed (notably the session fixation and unvalidated redirect items listed in your scope report). Specifically we need the following by EOD 2026-07-24: 

- Redacted screenshots showing the fixed UI flows and any relevant admin consoles.
- Short, redacted configuration snippets demonstrating the changed values (no secrets).
- Ticket/Jira references that map to each remediation and a brief status note (closed/verified).
- Any compensating controls implemented (WAF rules, monitoring alerts, MFA enforcement) with short descriptions and retention/alerting windows.
- If available, a CAIQ mapping update or SIG-lite confirmation and the relevant SOC 2 report access instructions (we may need limited access).

If you can't provide everything by the 24th, please let me know which items will be delayed and an expected delivery date. We may redact anything that looks like operational secrets but need enough detail to verify the fix.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Security Assurance Lead, FinCo
security@finco.com

--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <security@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a concise package that meets the items you listed. Quick notes: 

- Engineering has produced redacted config snippets and screenshots from the staging run where the fixes were validated (we will remove any secrets).
- Tickets: SUP-7894 and SUP-7895 contain the remediation work; both will be marked closed with verification comments.
- Compensating controls: we've added a targeted WAF rule set, enabled stricter session token rotation (KV store rotation + 2m TTL), and added an alerting rule in our monitoring pipeline for suspicious redirect patterns.

Attachments we intend to share (redacted): patch-7894-summary.txt, screenshot-patch-20260719.png, config-rotation-snippet.txt, waf-rules-export-20260719.json, logs-redacted-scan-20260719.csv.

We can provide a CAIQ mapping PDF for the FinCo scope and a link to our SOC 2 report. The SOC 2 report is behind a gated link and will require a signed access agreement — we can start that immediately and share instructions.

I'll have Marissa compile the package and send it shortly. If you prefer a short call to walk through the artifacts, we can do 30 minutes tomorrow morning.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <security@finco.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls

Hi Elena — attaching the compiled materials for the findings you flagged. Below is a short mapping and the attachments included.

Mapping summary (short):
- Finding A: session fixation / token handling -> SUP-7894 (closed, verified 2026-07-19) -> see screenshot-patch-20260719.png and config-rotation-snippet.txt
- Finding B: unvalidated redirect -> SUP-7895 (closed, verified 2026-07-19) -> see waf-rules-export-20260719.json and logs-redacted-scan-20260719.csv

Attachments (redacted where appropriate):
- patch-7894-summary.txt (one-page summary of changes and verification steps)
- screenshot-patch-20260719.png (UI flow showing token regeneration on login)
- config-rotation-snippet.txt (redacted kv rotation snippet; values replaced with placeholders)
- waf-rules-export-20260719.json (export of the rule set applied to production edge)
- logs-redacted-scan-20260719.csv (scans demonstrating the redirect attempts pre/post fix — IPs and user IDs redacted)
- CAIQ-mapping-FinCo-2026.pdf (mapping of CAIQ control IDs relevant to the scope)

Inline example (redacted) from config-rotation-snippet.txt:
- key_rotation_interval: "PT2M"
- max_token_ttl_seconds: "120"
- token_rotation_enabled: "true"

WAF rule note: The rule applied is a permanent rule with an initial tuning window that ran for 48 hours to reduce false positives; it's now enforced + logged. Alerts were added to the redirect-monitoring stream (severity: high) with a 1-minute aggregation window.

SOC 2 access: We can share a gated link; I have included SOC2-2026-access-instructions.txt as a text artifact describing the access process (requires signing a standard NDA/LOU). If you prefer, we can start the access request for FinCo now.

Let me know if you need further redaction or a specific format for the CAIQ mapping. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call as Jon suggested.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security and Compliance PM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

--

Cc: Paul Darcy <paul.darcy@finco.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls

Marissa — thanks for the package, that helps. A couple of quick clarifications before we mark items verified: 

1) Config snippets: we appreciate redaction. Can you confirm that the snippet includes all relevant parameter names (so we can validate the setting changed) but will not contain key material or plaintext credentials?

2) WAF rule permanence: You indicated it is permanent after tuning. Can you provide a short sentence we can include in our report stating whether the rule is intended as a long-term mitigation (and whether it will be carried forward during config rollouts)?

3) SOC2 coverage: if you share the SOC2 link, can you also confirm the date range covered by the report (so we map the controls to our assessment window)?

If you can send those three clarifications (a sentence each) and confirm delivery of the CAIQ PDF we should be able to complete our verification. Thanks — we may redact any artifacts before publishing internally but need the details to close the ticket.

Regards,
Elena Morales
Security Assurance Lead, FinCo

--
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <security@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Closure artifacts requested for vulnerability remediation and compensating controls

Elena —

Thanks for the questions. Short answers below for your report: 

1) Config snippets: confirmed — the snippets include parameter names and placeholder values only (no API keys, secret material, or production tokens). Example line we shared: "max_token_ttl_seconds: \"120\"".

2) WAF rule permanence: the redirect-targeting WAF rule was promoted to our permanent rule set after a 48-hour tuning window; it is tracked in our infra config repo and will be preserved across standard config rollouts unless a change request is approved. We will also include it in the pre-deploy checklists to ensure persistence.

3) SOC 2 coverage: the SOC 2 Type II report available for gated access covers the period 2026-01-01 through 2026-06-30. Per our process, we provide a restricted PDF via a signed access agreement; see SOC2-2026-access-instructions.txt for details and a link to request access.

We've sent the CAIQ mapping PDF as part of the package. If you'd like, we can execute the SOC2 access agreement for FinCo now and notify you when the document is available — or we can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough to review the artifacts together.

Let me know which you prefer.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
